from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

# In obs_0016: table is centered around x=200? Wait, looking at the image obs_0016:
# The brown rectangular table is right in front!
# Let check all brownish pixels in obs_0016:
arr = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0016.png"))
# find pixels where R > G > B and R in [100, 180]
m = (arr[:, :, 0] > 100) & (arr[:, :, 0] < 180) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 50) & (arr[:, :, 1] < 100) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 50)
# Exclude the plant pot on the left (x < 100)
m[:, :100] = False
y, x = np.where(m)
print(f"Table in obs_0016: x range [{x.min()}, {x.max()}], mean={x.mean():.1f}, y range [{y.min()}, {y.max()}]")

y17, x17 = np.where(m17)
print(f"Table in obs_0017: x range [{x17.min()}, {x17.max()}], mean={x17.mean():.1f}, y range [{y17.min()}, {y17.max()}]")
'
